beats.label: S1 · The deal
beats.text: Hockey captain Garrett, failing philosophy, recruits top student Hannah to tutor him. They agree to fake-date so she can catch her crush Justin's eye.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The premise that everything else grows from — the arrangement that puts these two in each other's orbit.

beats.label: S1 · Her secret
beats.text: Drunk one night, Hannah asks Garrett to help her have an orgasm. She then reveals she was raped by a hockey player in high school and struggles with intimacy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes their arrangement into real trust and sets up the antagonist who returns later in the season.

beats.label: S1 · Real feelings
beats.text: Garrett falls for Hannah, but she tells him their deal worked and Justin likes her. Realising it's Garrett she wants, she sings to him at the rink and they become a real couple.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The fake relationship becomes real — the emotional foundation the rest of the season tests.

beats.label: S1 · Garrett's father
beats.text: At Thanksgiving, Garrett sees his father Phil abusing his new fiancée the way he abused Garrett's late mother. He confides in Hannah his fear of becoming Phil.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Garrett's core wound and why hockey — Phil's project — sits so uneasily on him.

beats.label: S1 · Allie and Dean
beats.text: Newly single Allie starts secretly hooking up with Dean, insisting it stay casual to spare her ex Sean. Sean walks in on her and realises she's already moved on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The B-couple thread whose unresolved terms carry directly into the next season.

beats.label: S1 · The rapist on the ice
beats.text: Playing rival Aaron Delaney — Hannah's rapist, unknown to Garrett — Garrett beats him bloody after Aaron insults her. Hannah, furious he fought for her, breaks up with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rupture that tests whether the relationship is built on more than the deal.

beats.label: S1 · Reconciliation, new arrival
beats.text: Hannah performs a song about her trauma; Garrett apologises and they reunite. Meanwhile John recruits Hunter to replace suspended Garrett — and Hunter immediately clashes with Dean.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the main romance and plants Hunter, whose arrival reshapes the group going forward.

cliffhanger.text: Hannah and Garrett are together and honest with each other for the first time. Allie is quietly sleeping with Dean while sleeping with other men to keep it casual — and the new Hawks recruit Hunter, who she also slept with, has walked into their lives with a grudge against Dean.
questions: Can Allie keep her thing with Dean casual now that Hunter is on the team?
What happened between Hunter and Dean's younger sister?
Will Garrett stay with hockey now that he's playing for himself and not Phil?

characters.name: Hannah Wells
characters.line: Music major and Garrett's girlfriend; a survivor of assault who has just written a song about it and started to reclaim her body.

characters.name: Garrett Graham
characters.line: Bruins-drafted Hawks captain and Hannah's boyfriend, learning to want hockey for himself rather than for his abusive father.

characters.name: Allie Hayworth
characters.line: Hannah's roommate, freshly out of a long relationship with Sean and secretly sleeping with Dean while insisting it stay casual.

characters.name: Dean Di Laurentis
characters.line: Wealthy Hawks player quietly hung up on Allie despite her rules, and now feuding with new recruit Hunter.

characters.name: John Logan
characters.line: Garrett's best friend and the Hawks' new captain after Garrett stepped down; the one who brought Hunter onto the team.

characters.name: Hunter Davenport
characters.line: New Hawks recruit who slept with Allie once at a bar and holds a serious, unexplained grudge against Dean over Dean's younger sister.

characters.name: Phil Graham
characters.line: Garrett's father, revealed as the man who beat Garrett's late mother and is now abusing his new fiancée Cindy.

characters.name: Justin Kohl
characters.line: Hannah's original crush; nudged her toward realising it was Garrett she wanted and now out of the romantic picture.

characters.name: Tucker
characters.line: Hawks teammate in Garrett and Logan's inner circle.
